sentences.text: Cr.R. No.608/2015 11.06.2015  Shri Ashish Jaiswal, learned counsel for the applicant.
Shri R.S. Bais, learned Dy. Government Advocate for the respondent/State.
Heard on I.A.No.4036/2015, which is an application for hearing during summer vacation.
On due consideration, the application is allowed & disposed of.
Heard on I.A. No. 4035/2015, which is an application under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. for suspension of execution of jail sentence and grant of bail.

The applicant has been convicted under Section 7(1)16(1) (A) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo 6 months R.I. and fine of Rs. 1000/- vide judgment dated 30.05.2015,
passed by VII Additional Sessions Judge, Indore in Criminal Appeal No. 384/2011.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has wrongly been convicted.
Learned trial court has not correctly appreciated the evidence and the applicant is in custody since 30.05.2015.
Final disposal of this revision is likely to take time, hence prayed for suspension of sentence.
Prayer is opposed by the learned Govt. Advocate for the respondent/State.
Taking into consideration the aforesaid submissions and the fact that disposal of the revision is likely to take time, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the jail sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
The applicant is directed to appear before the Registry of this Court on 13.07.2015 and on all such other dates as may be fixed in this behalf.

Accordingly, the application (I.A.No.4035/2015) stands disposed of.
C.c.as per rules.
(D.K. Paliwal) Vacation Judge Karuna Ajay vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2015 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143357362/
